comments.body: Off by one: the loop runs `i <= retries`, so it attempts retries+1 times and hammers the backend an extra time on every failure.

comments.body: Never mind — rechecked: `retries` counts the initial attempt in this codebase, so `<=` is exactly right. My claim was wrong; resolving as invalid.
